mode: AB-R additional exact homonym adversarial search
prior: C15 3 long-span >=35-year repeated full names were all positive same-person links officially cross-documented, so ultra-long span alone is not discriminating.
H1: Among repeated full names spanning 20-34 years and changing province, one fixed candidate can be distinguished as a true exact full-name homonym by official historical birth dates or incompatible individual profiles.
H0: Those candidates may be long political careers moving constituencies; nothing certifies a negative match in selected sample.
selection: From full 5,600-row Interior original, select normalized name labels with at least two election dates and span >=20 and <35; require at least two province codes; order descending by year span, ascending by label; inspect first up to eight, no post-hoc name chasing. No official source link accepted solely from party or province.
confirm_negative: Two independent official Parliament/BOE biographies with exact normalized full name and incompatible DOB or explicit distinct institutional persons, both tied to the candidate election and province period.
confirm_positive: Same DOB and source-maintained parliamentary historical bio explicitly listing both terms.
other: Unresolved when no DOB/history evidence; rate is not population estimate.
cost: No Github Actions. Private Interior rows remain local.
limitations: Candidate selection after previous C15 findings, still exploratory not blind; acceptance limited to the fixed small sample.
